# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release receives security updates.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report vulnerabilities privately through the repository's
[security advisory form](https://github.com/neodymium6/agent-knowledge/security/advisories/new).
Do not open a public issue for an undisclosed vulnerability.

Include the affected version, impact, reproduction steps, and any suggested
mitigation. You should receive an acknowledgement within seven days. No
response or resolution deadline is guaranteed while the project is maintained
by volunteers.
